font.newspaper.note: Newspaper font size is a fixed value: not px, and it does not scale with the game's resolution — it stays the same size regardless of screen scaling. This number roughly corresponds to native's lineHeight (used for category-threshold comparison, not an exact conversion); font2~4 are automatically derived from font1 by subtracting fixed amounts (−14/−28/−30, minimums 22/10/8). Face/weight/width/spacing/Y offset for font2~4 always follow font1 and cannot be adjusted individually. Testing shows CJK glyphs don't overlap between 38 and 42.

general.NormalFontReplace.desc: When disabled, native GetGlyph always leaves CJK glyphs missing — general menus, briefing objectives, and the newspaper all show blank text, and [FontCjk]/[FontNewspaper] are not applied. This also skips installing texture-page registration, scene-switch texture refresh, and the Inventory/shop label width fix. Subtitles use a separate self-render path and are unaffected.
general.Utf8ReencodeFix.desc: Fixes garbled text caused by the shared function sub_5A4850 mistakenly re-encoding already-UTF-8 translated text byte-by-byte as ANSI. Keep this enabled normally.
general.GlyphHook: CJK Glyph Compositing / Subtitle Master Switch
general.GlyphHook.desc: An inline patch at the GetGlyph call site that acts as the master switch for CJK glyph compositing and subtitle self-render. When disabled, on-screen CJK reverts to native's blank missing-glyph display, and the subtitle feature also stops working.
general.ToUpperHook.desc: Fixes byte corruption caused by native calling CRT toupper() on CJK code points (garbled text on buttons/HUD/key-binding menus). Keep this enabled normally.
general.ZipPathTrace.desc: Records the most recent scene zip path; this is the required data source shared by original/translated LOC path derivation, briefing subtitle scene detection, and newspaper category detection. Turning this off breaks Chinese translation/original text, briefing subtitles, and newspaper categorization entirely — don't turn it off under normal use. Per-call trace logging is controlled separately by [Debug] DebugZipPathTrace.
locswitch.hotkey.desc: Press this key in-game to toggle on-screen display between the original LOC text and the Chinese translation (triggers on key-down; holding it does not repeat-toggle).
subtitle.BriefingSubtitleEnabled.desc: Adds subtitles for the mission briefing's opening narration (native's playback path for this doesn't show subtitles). Also controls both recording the voice-start signal and displaying the subtitle text.
subtitle.DialogueSubtitleEnabled.desc: Adds subtitles for two-person dialogue (sub_6AACA0). Native's display path for this has no subtitle step by design.
subtitle.OnelinersSubtitleEnabled.desc: Adds subtitles for single-character event reaction barks (alerts / body discovery / idle chatter, sub_6A4240) and the M04 fake-death easter-egg line (sub_6BACC0).
subtitle.NpcHearRadius.desc: Subtitles for NPC dialogue/barks are hidden once the distance to the player character exceeds this value (to avoid showing background dialogue that can't be heard). Units unconfirmed, tune in-game; 0 = disable filtering (shown map-wide). Default 1000.
subtitle.WalkieSubtitleEnabled.desc: Adds subtitles for in-level NPC walkie-talkie transmissions (sub_6C0220).
subtitle.TvRadioSubtitleEnabled.desc: Adds subtitles for in-level TV news/radio broadcasts (sub_4C5E10).
subtitle.TvRadioHearRadius.desc: Subtitles are hidden once the distance from the broadcast sound source to the player character exceeds this value (broadcasts loop across the whole level from the moment it loads, and the sound usually carries through multiple rooms, so this threshold is larger than the NPC dialogue one). Same units as NpcHearRadius; 0 = disable filtering (shown map-wide). Default 3000.
subtitle.place.SubtitlePlaceFirst.desc: Screen position of the primary subtitle slot (shared by the Dialogue/Oneliners primary slot and the opening briefing subtitle). X/Y are screen percentages, 0 = leftmost/topmost, 100 = rightmost/bottommost, out-of-range values are auto-clamped. Default 50,80.
subtitle.place.SubtitlePlaceThird.desc: Screen position of the tertiary subtitle slot (used by the 8-state state machine when both the primary and secondary slots are occupied). The secondary slot keeps native's original subtitle position and has no corresponding setting. Default 60,90.
newspaper.NewsPaperImageWrapFix.desc: Fixes newspaper text wrapping: native reads an uninitialized stack value when computing the narrowed width/bottom edge beside images, causing the image position to drift upward in the CJK build. Only takes effect in the newspaper category.
newspaper.NewsPaperSpaceAdvanceFix.desc: Fixes glyph overlap across the whole newspaper article: the space character now re-queries GetGlyph(32) on the spot instead of reusing the stale pointer captured on function entry. Only takes effect in the newspaper category.
newspaper.NewsPaperLineHeightFix.desc: Fixes headline glyph overlap: the running-max line height now uses the correct lineHeight our patch detected, instead of a field that may have been corrupted. Only takes effect in the newspaper category.
newspaper.NewsPaperJustifyFillFix.desc: Newspaper <justify fill> full-justification pushes line-end text off (even over images) under CJK; when enabled, the newspaper category is treated as <justify left> instead. Non-newspaper categories are unaffected.
newspaper.NewsPaperSoftBreakFix.desc: Inserts a space every few characters in the newspaper's CJK translation as a candidate line-break point, bringing the line-break density back closer to the English version to avoid crammed text/overflow. Only applies to the newspaper's CJK translation, does not touch the F11 original text.
newspaper.SoftBreakCjkInterval.desc: Insertion interval for the switch above: insert one space every N consecutive CJK characters. Default 6, 0 = never insert.
hud.TrespassingEnabled.desc: Shows custom on-screen text when the player enters a trespassing/hostile zone.
hud.WarningEnabled.desc: Shows status text when AI is SUSPICIOUS or ALERTED.
hud.WarningPos.desc: Screen-percentage coordinates, centered near the top of the screen. Default 50,5.
hud.MinimapPos.desc: Screen-percentage coordinates of the minimap's top-left corner. Default 5.0,60.0.
hud.MinimapSize.desc: Actual side length in pixels = this value × 10, range 0~100 (0 = don't draw). Only accepts plain decimal integers; an invalid format falls back to the default value 15 in-game. Default 15.
hud.MinimapZoom.desc: The number of world units visible horizontally inside the minimap box — smaller values zoom in more and scroll centered on the player; 0 = scale the whole floor proportionally to fill the box (see the full layout, no scrolling). Negative values fall back to 0 in-game. Default 4000.
debug.header: [Debug] Diagnostic switches — except for "CJK missing-glyph placeholder," the rest only affect log output volume and don't affect display behavior.
debug.GlyphDiagEnable.desc: Prints one line of detail per CJK glyph composite (includes the cap count; goes silent once the cap is reached).
debug.CJKPlaceholderEnable.desc: Replaces CJK code points with '@' before calling native GetGlyph. ★The only diagnostic switch that changes display behavior — keep this off normally.
debug.TexUploadDiagEnable.desc: Detail log for uploading GDI bitmaps as D3D9 textures.
debug.LocSwitchDiagEnable.desc: Prints one line per LOC lookup hit/miss — very high volume.
debug.ToUpperDiagEnable.desc: Records the code point received by the hooked toupper().
debug.NativeTexRegDiagEnable.desc: Detail log for native texture-page slot registration/invalidation.
debug.DebugSubtitleDiagEnable.desc: Shared subtitle detail log for Briefing/Dialogue/Oneliners (includes NPC distance calibration). Install success/failure logging is unaffected.
debug.LabelWidthFixDiagEnable.desc: Detail log for the label:value width fix in the Inventory weapon panel / shop Price.
debug.DebugZipPathTrace.desc: Per-call trace log for scene zip path recording (whether recording is installed at all is controlled by [General] ZipPathTrace, not this).
debug.HudDiagEnable.desc: Prints a zoneKind→level detail log every time TrespassHud registers a hit.
debug.MinimapFloorProbe.desc: Dumps the player's coordinates / currently-selected floor / zone node name, etc. once per second, for offline comparison of the minimap floor-selection logic — pure recording, doesn't affect drawing. Should be turned off once comparison is done.
debug.GlyphOverrunProbe.desc: Locates stack/atlas overruns in the newspaper's CJK glyph-compositing path — only prints on the newspaper screen, pure recording.
